I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message to say the 25 August deadline for Tansley Parcel's signed order form is noted. I told her I don't keep separate records, so her message in the channel is the record.

I also pointed out that today is 14 October, so 25 August has already passed, and asked if that's the right date or if she meant another one. I couldn't check it myself because there are no Tansley Parcel files in the share I can see.

I took no other action, since she said none was needed.
